description: Fetch a Kickstarter creator's profile (name, bio, website, location, join date, backed count) plus their launched projects list with funding state and percent funded, from /profile/{name}. Supports profile slug or full profile URL, paginates projects beyond 32, and reports invalid creators (404) and Cloudflare blocks.

parameters.name: creator
parameters.description: Creator profile name (slug) or full profile URL, e.g. baroque or https://www.kickstarter.com/profile/baroque

parameters.name: max_pages
parameters.description: Max pages of created projects to fetch (32 projects per page; default 6, i.e. up to 192 projects). Stops early when all projects are collected.
